# ast-grep-cli for the structural lint rules in ci.yml's architecture job, installed with
# pip install --require-hashes. It has no dependencies. Regenerate when the pin moves:
#   printf 'ast-grep-cli==<version>\n' > ast-grep.in
#   uv pip compile ast-grep.in --generate-hashes --python-version 3.12 \
#     --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --no-header -o .github/requirements/ast-grep.txt
# then delete the `# via` line, which names the local path of ast-grep.in.
